author: reek
body: Map viewer with search, layers, and points of interest. Eight US city pins with temperature, elevation, population, and timezone. Search filters pins by name prefix. Zoom tracks magnification level. Compass rotates bearing by 90 degrees on click. Distance calculation between pins uses scaled coordinate approximation.

author: reek
body: Approximate distance between two pins using cosine-adjusted Euclidean distance on lat/lon coordinates (x1000). Latitude: 69 mi/deg, longitude: ~50 mi/deg (cosine factor for US latitudes 30-48N). Formula: sqrt((dlat*69)^2 + (dlon*50)^2) with coords in thousandths.
